notes:
{会社|かいしゃ} means company or corporation, and also refers to one's workplace.

WRITING:
{会|かい} (meeting) + {社|しゃ} (shrine/company) - an organization where people meet to work.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {会社|かいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to work (lit. "go to the company")
- {会社|かいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{辞|や}める→やめる：00909_yameru⟧: to quit one's job
- {会社|かいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join a company

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧: company employee, office worker
- ⟦{株式|かぶしき}{会社|がいしゃ}→株式会社：19101_kabushikigaisha⟧: stock company (often abbreviated as ⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧)
- ⟦{有限|ゆうげん}{会社|がいしゃ}→有限会社：27499_yuugengaisha⟧: limited company

USAGE:
{会社|かいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ can mean both "going to the company (building)" and "going to work" depending on context.
